edges: Doctor Strange first appeared in the role in the 2016 film Doctor Strange.
Doctor Strange never appears in American comic books published by Marvel Comics.

neighbors: Wizard's 200 Greatest Comic Book Characters of All Time
edges: Doctor Strange is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics.
Doctor Strange was created by artist Steve Ditko.
Doctor Strange was created by writer Stan Lee.
Doctor Strange was ranked 83rd in Wizard's 200 Greatest Comic Book Characters of All Time list in 2008.
Doctor Strange was ranked 33rd in IGN's list of The Top 50 Avengers in 2012.
